scenes.narration: Networking is one part of your career momentum.
The other part is visibility—making sure the right people can actually see your contributions and your potential. Visibility isn't about self-promotion for its own sake.

vars.lines: See your contributions|See your potential|Not self-promotion

scenes.narration: It's about making sure that decision-makers, sponsors, and peers understand what you're working on, where you're growing, and how you add value. So what are visibility actions?

vars.lines: What you're working on|Where you're growing|How you add value

scenes.narration: They're small, intentional behaviors that put your work and insights where others can see them, link your name to meaningful contributions, and build a consistent reputation over time.
